correctness.rationale: For cyclic three-site system dot x_i=x_i-x_i^3+d(x_{i-1}-2x_i+x_{i+1}), d>=0, each stationary coordinate is a root of shared depressed cubic t^3-(1-3d)t-dS. All equal, all distinct, and exactly two equal cases are exhaustive; latter (u,v,v) yields d=-r(r+1)/(r^3+2), v^2=(r+2)/(r^3+2), r<-2 or -1<r<0. P(r)=r^4+2r^3-4r-2 uniquely vanishes on (-1,0), producing the ordinary sixfold fold at unique d*=root(108d^4-36d^2+12d-1) in (0,1/3). Eigenvalue antisymmetric mode and exact 2x2 trace/determinant distinguish sinks vs saddles; all-distinct are saddles for 0<d<1/3. Counts d0:27/8 sinks, 0<d<d*:27/8, d*:21/2, d*<d<1/3:15/2, d>=1/3:3/2. At fold zero eigenvalues make the coalescing states non-exponentially attracting; no basin claims. Symbolic rational identities and branch signs checked independently.
